title: Mitigating the Length-Scaling Tax with Online Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38854v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Length scaling during reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training is often viewed as a sign of improved reasoning ability, especially on difficult problems, but may also make responses to already-solved problems unnecessarily verbose. We quantify this side effect as the length-scaling tax (LST): excess response length on already-solved queries without a commensurate accuracy gain. To mitigate LST, we propose Length Self-Distillation (LSD), which routes solved prompts to on-policy distillation and retains the original RL objective for unsolved prompts. LSD uses an exponential moving average of the online policy as its teacher, requiring no external model. We find that LSD achieves comparable or better performance than RL across multiple variants, while substantially curbing response-length growth on easy queries. LSD reduces LST from 19.0% to -3.7% on single-turn reasoning and from 31.4% to 13.7% on multi-turn agentic tasks, demonstrating

translated_title: 用在线蒸馏缓解长度扩展税
translated_abstract: 在强化学习（RL）后训练过程中，长度扩展通常被视为推理能力提升的标志，尤其是在困难问题上，但它也可能使对已解决问题的回答变得不必要的冗长。我们将这种副作用量化为长度扩展税（LST）：即在已解决的查询上，响应长度的过度增长没有带来相应的准确率提升。为了缓解LST，我们提出了长度自蒸馏（LSD）方法，该方法将已解决的提示路由到在线策略蒸馏，而对未解决的提示保留原始的RL目标。LSD使用在线策略的指数移动平均作为其教师模型，无需任何外部模型。我们发现，LSD在多个变体上实现了与RL相当或更好的性能，同时显著抑制了简单查询上响应长度的增长。LSD将单轮推理中的LST从19.0%降至-3.7%，将多轮智能体任务中的LST从31.4%降至13.7%，这表明……
tldr: 提出长度自蒸馏（LSD）方法，通过将已解决的提示转向在线自蒸馏（以在线策略的指数移动平均作为教师，无需外部模型）而对未解决的提示保留RL目标，在保持或超越RL性能的同时显著减少已解决问题上不必要的冗长响应，将单轮推理的长度扩展税从19.0%降至-3.7%。
en_tdlr: Proposes Length Self-Distillation (LSD), which routes solved prompts to on-policy self-distillation using an EMA of the online policy as teacher (no external model needed) while retaining RL for unsolved prompts, achieving comparable or better performance than RL while substantially curbing unnecessary response-length growth, reducing the length-scaling tax from 19.0% to -3.7% on single-turn reasoning.
